change: New: Known Issues tracker — Supervisor can defer a found problem (no parts/no manpower/temp fix) as a note tied to the truck instead of an active job; it auto-reminds next time that truck is inspected, with one-tap 'Add to Job Card' or 'Resolve'. New Manager download: Known Issues (Deferred Repairs) export, fleet-wide. Also fixed a pre-existing bug where the Incharge complaint-verdict panel silently failed to render for trucks with a matched appointment (mismatched element IDs).
